target.title: fix(cli): align gateway agent timeout default
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Closes #98180.

Generic agent examples still carried `timeoutSeconds: 600`, and gateway-backed `openclaw agent` calls historically sent that same ten-minute fallback when `--timeout` was omitted. That made a CLI-local fallback override the gateway server's own `agents.defaults.timeoutSeconds` policy.

## Why This Change Was Made

The gateway is the owner of agent runtime timeout policy. This change therefore removes the generic 600-second examples and omits the optional RPC `timeout` field when the caller does not provide `--timeout`. The server then resolves its configured timeout or shared 48-hour default. Explicit `--timeout`, including `--timeout 0`, remains a per-run override.

This is the server-owned timeout shape previously proven in closed PR #98186, not the earlier client-side 48-hour override shape.

## User Impact

- Omitted `--timeout`: no `params.timeout` is sent; gateway configuration/defaults own the run timeout.
- Explicit `--timeout 45`: sends `params.timeout: 45`.
- Explicit `--timeout 0`: sends `params.timeout: 0` and preserves no-timeout semantics.
- Generic docs no longer encourage an accidental ten-minute cap.

## Real Behavior Proof

Exact head: `d2495e4cbba5d8af00118d2afa879a51b11515cc`.

The focused gateway-dispatch test exercises the real CLI request builder and asserts that an omitted CLI timeout does **not** add `params.timeout`, while the client-side wait uses the timer-safe ceiling (`2_147_000_000ms`) so it cannot preempt a longer server-owned timeout. Explicit numeric and zero overrides are separately covered.

Local exact-head verification after merging current `main`:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/agent-via-gateway.test.ts` — 1 file passed, 74 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --type-aware --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/commands/agent-via-gateway.ts src/commands/agent-via-gateway.test.ts` — 0 warnings, 0 errors.
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/commands/agent-via-gateway.ts src/commands/agent-via-gateway.test.ts` — clean.
- `node scripts/format-docs.mjs --check docs/gateway/config-agents.md docs/gateway/configuration-examples.md` — docs formatting clean (688 files).
- `node scripts/check-docs-mdx.mjs docs/gateway/config-agents.md docs/gateway/configuration-examples.md` — passed (2 files).
- `git diff --check` — passed.

## Evidence

Current gateway protocol and server behavior support the owner boundary directly:

- `packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/agent.ts` declares `timeout` optional.
- `src/gateway/server-methods/agent.ts` passes an override to `resolveAgentTimeoutMs` only when `request.timeout` is numeric.
- Therefore omission preserves gateway config/default ownership; serializing a local 48-hour value would not.

## Scope

This intentionally does not change explicitly configured server timeout values or explicit CLI overrides. It only removes generic 600-second examples and changes omitted CLI timeout behavior from a hidden client override to server ownership.
